title: ID0389315-DC/Si-D/FI [liZll0] - Beta v5.0.22 all outlet OoO
description:
We are beta testing v5.0.22 in our chargers. We just installed it to this one couple a days ago and now all outlets are OoO with Error code 8
Root cause: Fw bug in EcoG layer 1.6.1
Solution: Rollback to old layer on EcoG
